idea-plugin.name: Structurizr DSL
idea-plugin.description:
Structurizr DSL — Architecture Diagrams as Code in Your IDE

Full language support for Structurizr DSL — the industry-standard text-based language for defining C4 model architecture diagrams. Write, navigate, and preview your software architecture directly in your JetBrains IDE with all the features developers expect.

Editing and Authoring

  • Syntax Highlighting — Full colorization for keywords, strings, comments, identifiers, and variable substitutions
  • Intelligent Code Completion — Context-aware suggestions for elements, relationships, views, and properties, including smart relationship-target completion
  • 21 Live Templates — Quick scaffolding for workspaces, systems, containers, components, views, groups, and more
  • Color Preview — Gutter swatches for hex colors in styles with a built-in color picker
  • Code Folding and Formatting — Collapse blocks and auto-format DSL files with configurable style

Navigation and Analysis

  • Go to Definition — Ctrl+Click to jump to element definitions
  • Find Usages — Alt+F7 to find all references to an element
  • Structure View — Hierarchical tree of workspace, model, views, and elements
  • 10 Code Inspections — Detects errors like undefined references, duplicate identifiers, duplicate view keys, and invalid colors with quick fixes

Diagram Preview and Export

  • Live Diagram Preview — Real-time C4 diagram rendering as you type
  • Split Editor — Side-by-side DSL code and diagram view
  • Multi-Format Export — Export as SVG, PNG, PlantUML, or Mermaid
  • Copy to Clipboard — Copy diagrams in any format for instant sharing
  • CLI Integration — Uses an installed Structurizr CLI for PlantUML, Mermaid, DOT and JSON export

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE 2024.3+ (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, CLion, and all others)
  • Windows, macOS, or Linux

Support

  • Issue Tracker
  • Structurizr DSL Language Reference
  • C4 Model Documentation
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.9.0

  • PNG export and Copy as Image produced a placeholder ("install Structurizr CLI") instead of the diagram. They now rasterize the same diagram the preview shows; PNG size fits the configured maximum width/height.
  • Export dialog view picker offered fixed view types ("Container", "Deployment", …) that did not match any view key, so the default view was exported instead. It now lists the views the workspace actually defines; "Export all views" uses the real view keys.
  • CLI-based exports failed with "Structurizr CLI not found" unless the CLI had been located earlier in the session; the CLI path from settings was ignored. The configured path (global or per project) is used first, and the CLI timeout setting is honoured.
  • PlantUML and Mermaid export/copy without the CLI now convert the selected view (elements, boundaries, relationships) instead of regex-scraping persons and systems from the whole file.
  • Settings that had no effect were removed (embedded CLI, zoom, dark mode, system theme, metadata, editor/completion toggles that duplicate IDE settings). The remaining ones now work: preview on/off, refresh while typing and its delay (global or per project), default export format and directory, open file after export.
  • "Identifier" on the color settings page now changes identifier colour (default look unchanged).
  • Removed: Unused StructurizrCliWrapper and the never-called CLI download code.

2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/structurizr-dsl-plugin

2026.6.4 — Preview Opens Ready

  • Fixed: the preview showed "Open a .dsl file" until you clicked Refresh — when a .dsl file or the Structurizr Preview tool window was opened, the first diagram could be overwritten by the placeholder page while the embedded browser was still starting. The diagram now appears straight away

2026.6.3 — Preview & Structure View Fixes

  • The preview shows the view you select — instead of a grid of every element, each view is drawn with its real content: people and systems for a landscape, the system and its neighbours for a context view, the containers or components of the scope inside a boundary, deployment nodes and instances, numbered dynamic steps, filtered views. include/exclude and !include are honoured, and SVG/PNG export uses the same renderer
  • The view selector lists the views of your workspace — by key, type and scope, and keeps your choice while you edit
  • Fixed: Refresh threw "Read access is allowed from inside read-action only"; the Refresh Structurizr Preview action now works too
  • Fixed: the Structure view lost the views of many workspaces — one statement the editor grammar did not know (lower-case autolayout, workspace name, x = deploymentEnvironment, text blocks, ...) broke parsing of the rest of the file. Keywords are now case-insensitive and unknown statements are skipped one at a time
  • Cleaner tool window — no more confusing "Preview" tab button; compact toolbar; the diagram fits the window

2026.6.2 — Stability Fix

  • Fixed NullPointerException when opening a .dsl file — semantic highlighting walked the PSI tree past the file into its directory, which has no syntax node, and threw Cannot invoke "ASTNode.getElementType()". It happened for any identifier outside a workspace { } block (e.g. included fragments or a file mid-edit) and showed an IDE error on every open. The same unbounded walk is fixed everywhere else it occurred (completion, inspections, quick fixes), so none of them can hit this error either

2026.6.1 — Compatibility Fix

  • Critical fix: .dsl files would not open on IntelliJ 2026.2 — IntelliJ 2026.2 moved JCEF out of the core platform into a separate bundled plugin, so the diagram preview could no longer resolve JBCefApp. The resulting NoClassDefFoundError took down the whole split editor: the tab flashed open and closed again, leaving no way to edit a .dsl file. The plugin now declares the JCEF module and the preview degrades to a message instead of failing
  • Editing never depends on the preview any more — if the embedded browser is missing or fails to start for any reason, the text editor, inspections and navigation keep working; only the diagram pane is replaced by an explanatory placeholder
  • Preview tool window hardened — the same guard now covers the Structurizr Preview tool window, which previously created a JCEF browser unconditionally

2026.6.0 — Productivity Release

  • Critical fix: language engine restored — A lexer table-unpacking defect made every file tokenize as one bad character, silently disabling the parser, inspections, navigation, structure view, and identifier completion. All language features now actually work as advertised
  • Color Preview & Picker — Hex colors in element/relationship styles now show a swatch in the editor gutter; click it to change the color with the IDE color picker
  • Smart Relationship Completion (FR-306) — Completing after -> now suggests only defined elements (excluding the source), ranked above keywords
  • Duplicate View Key Inspection (FR-507) — Detects views sharing the same key, which Structurizr rejects at export time
  • 4 New Live Templates — grp (group), props (properties), anim (animation), autolay (autoLayout) — 21 templates total
  • Fixed: colour (British spelling) values are now validated by the invalid-color inspection
  • Performance: Duplicate identifier inspection no longer rescans the file for every element

2026.4.5 — Freemium Release

  • Freemium licensing — Released with product-descriptor for JetBrains Marketplace freemium model (code: PSTRUCTURIZRDSL)

What's New

  • Syntax Highlighting - Full colorization for keywords, strings, comments, identifiers, and variable substitutions in Structurizr DSL files
  • Intelligent Code Completion - Context-aware suggestions for elements, relationships, views, and all DSL keywords
  • Navigation and Find Usages - Go to definition, find usages, breadcrumbs, go-to-symbol, and line markers for quick code navigation
  • 9 Code Inspections - Detects undefined references, unused elements, duplicate identifiers, empty blocks, missing properties, deprecated keywords, invalid colors, invalid contexts, and invalid relationships
  • 10 Live Templates - Quick scaffolding for workspaces, persons, software systems, containers, components, relationships, and views
  • Code Folding and Formatting - Collapse DSL blocks and auto-format files with configurable code style settings
  • Live Diagram Preview - Real-time C4 diagram rendering with split editor view showing code and diagram side by side
  • Multi-Format Export - Export diagrams as SVG, PNG, PlantUML, or Mermaid with copy-to-clipboard support
  • Structurizr CLI Integration - Auto-download and manage the Structurizr CLI for rendering and validation
  • Rename Refactoring - Safely rename identifiers across all references in your DSL files
